title: Energizing Crumbly Jamaican Chicken Stew
description: This resinous, crumbly Jamaican dish is energizing and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly, featuring chicken thighs, spices, and herbs. A delicious and satisfying meal for any occasion.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of coconut oil to the wok and saut2e the onion until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic, allspice, thyme, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the wok and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Jamaican curry powder to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk to the wok and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the wok and cook until the stew has thickened and the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
Serve over rice or with naan bread, if desired.
